whySymmetry: tensor_symmetric_blocker.py records the stabiliser of the depth-2 problem as Aut(W33) wr C2 and then searches only inside cyclic subgroups acting by the twisted diagonal (p,q) -> (g(p), h(q)) with h a power of g. The 'wr C2' is the TRANSPOSE, and it is a genuine symmetry of the constraint set since S meets every tile L x M exactly when S^T does. That file named it and never used it; this file uses it.
theNullAt114: in both classes whose control resolves SAT, 114 returns UNKNOWN at 600 s. That is the FOURTH lever to come back null on 114, after the clock (36d3b4b), the group (cf9ecf7) and the encoding (e3ffec2).
whatItEstablishes: first, a TRANSPOSE-SYMMETRIC BLOCKER OF SIZE 115 EXISTS -- two classes return OPTIMAL at 115. The corpus's 115 was found inside <(g,h)> with no swap, so the known optimum is compatible with the FULL stabiliser including the wreathing C2 and is not an artifact of breaking that symmetry. Second, FIVE CLASSES CANNOT HOST A 115 AT ALL, proved INFEASIBLE rather than timed out; since tau_2 <= 115 those symmetry classes provably exclude every optimal blocker, which is a structural statement about which symmetries a near-optimal blocker can carry.
howToReadAVoidRow: a class with 115 INFEASIBLE and 114 INFEASIBLE has shown nothing about tau_2 -- only that the class is too restrictive to contain a blocker of either size. Reporting those two INFEASIBLEs as if they narrowed tau_2 would be the mistake this file exists to avoid. The control is what separates a measurement from a coincidence.
pureTransposeIsVoidToo: the pure transpose -- g = identity, 820 orbits -- exceeds the orbit cap and is skipped here, but was run separately as a direct 820-variable model at 115, 114 and 113 and returned UNKNOWN at every size. Fewer variables did not help because the constraints get denser, so it is void as well.
boundary: exact WITHIN each symmetry class: OPTIMAL and INFEASIBLE are proofs about invariant blockers, UNKNOWN is a statement about the solver and not about the class. Nothing here constrains tau_2 itself, which stays open in [111, 115]. Classes are keyed by CYCLE TYPE rather than element order, as tensor_symmetric_blocker .py warns; classes above the orbit cap are recorded as skipped rather than silently dropped.
